question:
When a number is divided by 14, the remainder is 9. If the square of the same number is divided by 14, then the remainder will be:

(CHSL 2019 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is option 1 i.e. 11.

Remainder = \(\frac{\left(9\right)^2}{14}\) 
= 81/14 → 11 Remainder

Alternatively:-
Let number = 14 + 9 = 23 
\(\frac{\left(23\right)^2}{14} = \frac{529}{14} \)
⇒ Remainder = 11
question_hi:
जब किसी संख्या को 14 से विभाजित किया जाता है, तो शेषफल 9 प्राप्त होता है। यदि उसी संख्या के वर्ग को 14 से विभाजित किया जाए, तो शेषफल होगा:

(CHSL 2019 Pre)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 1 अर्थात 11 है।

शेषफल = \(\frac{\left(9\right)^2}{14}\)
= 81/14 → 11 शेषफल

वैकल्पिक रूप से:-
माना संख्या = 14 + 9 = 23
\(\frac{\left(23\right)^2}{14} = \frac{529}{14}  \)
⇒ शेषफल = 11

question:

question:
A natural number n divides 732 and leaves 12 as a remainder. How many values of n are possible?

(CHSL 2024 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is option 2 i.e. 20.

732/n = 12  [n > 12]
732/n = 720 + 12
n, is a factor of 720 
720 → 24 × 32 × 51
Total factor = 5 × 3 × 2 = 30 
Ignoring the factor less than 12
n will be greater than 12
Possible values of n = 30 - 10 = 20

(CHSL 2024 Pre)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 2 अर्थात 20 है।

732/n = 12  [n > 12]

n, 720 का एक गुणनखंड है
720 → 24 × 32 × 51
कुल गुणनखंड = 5 × 3 × 2 = 30
12 से कम गुणनखंड को अनदेखा करे
n, 12 से बड़ा होगा
n के संभावित मान = 30 - 10 = 20

question:

question:
How many two-digit numbers are divisible by 3 or 5?

(CHSL 2021 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is option 3 i.e. 42.

Two digit numbers = 10 to 99

Total 2-digit numbers = 90 

Divisible by 3(from 12 to 99)

⇒ \(99-12\over3\) + 1 = 29 + 1 = 30

Divisible by 5(from 10 to 95)

⇒ \(95-10\over5\) + 1 = 17 + 1 = 18

Divisible by both 3 & 5(from 15 to 90)

⇒ \(90-15\over15\) = 5 + 1 = 6

∴ Total = 30 + 18 - 6 = 42

question:
How many integers between 299 and 501 are divisible by 4 or 10?

(SP Phase-9)
solution:
The correct answer is option 4 i.e. 61.

\(\frac{501}{4}=125\), \(\frac{299}{4}\) = 74
Numbers between 299 & 501 divisible by 4 = 125 - 74 = 51
\(\frac{501}{10}=\ 50\), \(\frac{299}{10}\) = 29 
Numbers between 299 & 501 divisible by 10 = 50 - 29 = 21
LCM of (4, 10) = 20 
\(\frac{501}{20}=\ 25\), \(\frac{299}{20}\) = 14 
Numbers between 299 and 501 divisible by 20 = 25 - 14 = 11
The total number between 299 and 501 divisible by 4 or 10 = 51 + 21 - 11 = 61

question:
How many numbers are there from 500 to 550 (including both) that are neither divisible by 3 nor by 11?

(SP Phase-9)
solution:
The correct answer is option 4 i.e. 30.

Numbers between 500 & 550 divisible by 3 = 183 - 167 + 1 = 17 
Numbers between 500 & 550 divisible by 11 = 50 - 46 + 1 = 5 
LCM of (3 & 11) = 33 
Numbers between 550 & 500 divisible by 33 = 16 - 16 + 1 = 1 
Total number = 17 + 5 - 1 = 22 - 1 = 21
Required number = 51 - 21 = 30
